import pandas as pd

def load_and_prepare_source(path: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Load a source CSV file and ensure the schema and data types match the target schema.
    """
    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    # Enforce correct dtypes according to target schema:
    # ['tripduration': int, 'starttime': str, 'stoptime': str,
    #  'start station id': int, 'start station name': str,
    #  'start station latitude': float, 'start station longitude': float,
    #  'end station id': int, 'end station name': str,
    #  'end station latitude': float, 'end station longitude': float,
    #  'bikeid': int, 'usertype': str, 'birth year': int, 'gender': int]

    # Convert columns to appropriate types, handling missing or malformed data gracefully
    df['tripduration'] = pd.to_numeric(df['tripduration'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df['starttime'] = df['starttime'].astype(str)
    df['stoptime'] = df['stoptime'].astype(str)
    df['start station id'] = pd.to_numeric(df['start station id'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df['start station name'] = df['start station name'].astype(str)
    df['start station latitude'] = pd.to_numeric(df['start station latitude'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    df['start station longitude'] = pd.to_numeric(df['start station longitude'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    df['end station id'] = pd.to_numeric(df['end station id'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df['end station name'] = df['end station name'].astype(str)
    df['end station latitude'] = pd.to_numeric(df['end station latitude'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    df['end station longitude'] = pd.to_numeric(df['end station longitude'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    df['bikeid'] = pd.to_numeric(df['bikeid'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df['usertype'] = df['usertype'].astype(str)
    df['birth year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['birth year'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df['gender'] = pd.to_numeric(df['gender'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

    return df

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_paths = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_49/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_49/test_1.csv"
    ]

    # Load and prepare each source DataFrame
    dfs = []
    for path in source_paths:
        df = load_and_prepare_source(path)
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source DataFrames into one target DataFrame
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    target_columns = [
        'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime',
        'start station id', 'start station name', 'start station latitude', 'start station longitude',
        'end station id', 'end station name', 'end station latitude', 'end station longitude',
        'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
    ]
    target_df = target_df[target_columns]

    # Save the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_49/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
